# BabyPeek

BabyPeek is an AI future baby photo generator by MehyarSoft LLC. Upload two parent photos and it dreams up a photorealistic portrait of what your baby could look like — a free sneak peek instantly, then a $5 one-time unlock for the full high-resolution portrait with instant download.

## Key pages

- / — landing page with the generator, free teaser, and $5 Stripe checkout
- /privacy/ — privacy policy: what is collected, what is never stored, how to unsubscribe
- /terms/ — terms of service: entertainment-only disclaimer, the $5 unlock, acceptable use

## Pricing

$5 one-time via Stripe, through the centralized https://mehyar.us/api/pay/checkout. The AI teaser (faceless sneak peek) is free; unlocking the full portrait is a single payment with no subscription. All sales final on instant digital delivery; technical failures are made right via info@mehyar.us.

## API

- POST /api/generate — multipart { photo1, photo2 } → generation id + free teaser image. KV rate-limited per IP.
- POST /api/checkout — { email } → Stripe checkout session for the $5 unlock.
- POST /api/redeem — links the Stripe success token to a generation. Paid-token verification is server-to-server against the central billing ledger; idempotent.
- GET /api/full/<id>?token= — the paid portrait, token-gated. Add ?download=1 to get it as an attachment.
- GET /api/unsubscribe?token= — one-click unsubscribe confirm page (HMAC-signed token, no login).

## Compliance

Entertainment only. BabyPeek does NOT claim to predict what any child will look like: portraits are AI imaginings based on visible features, not a genetic prediction, not medical advice, and not a promise of any outcome. No income claims, no health claims, no legal claims. Uploaded parent photos are processed in memory and never stored; only the AI-generated baby images are kept (to show them back to you). Email addresses are stored for unlock delivery and product updates; every marketing email carries a one-click unsubscribe link.
